From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@aurora-ml.com>
Cc: Aurora-ML Procurement <procurement@aurora-ml.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Risk flags — playbook + exec asks (Aurora-ML)

Team,

Attached is a first-pass risk-flag playbook for Aurora (aurora_risk_flags_v1.xlsx). I split the active opportunities into Red/Yellow/Green lists and called out the immediate owner-level actions we should take this week. High level:

- Red (blocking): "Aurora Core" — legal review delays + procurement requiring additional SOC evidence. Recommend scheduling a short CFO call and offering a 30-day pilot credit while we complete SOC docs.
- Yellow (at-risk but with clear runway): "Aurora Scale" — pricing pushback; buyer is evaluating dedicated vs hosted. Need a pricing flex proposal and a technical health-check with their infra lead.
- Green (on-track): smaller POCs; keep cadence and hold to commit date.

Asks (urgent):
1) Marissa — confirm whether we can offer a pilot credit up to $20k for Aurora Core (exec approval needed). If yes, I will escalate to Finance and request a one-time exception.
2) Jordan — can you run the infra health-check with Aurora's platform lead (Elena) tomorrow morning? Call id: 30m.
3) Sean — please attach the SOC evidence packet and a brief note on retention policy for procurement; Aurora asked for examples of audit logs (see attachment).

Elena — thanks for the quick discovery last week. If you can confirm the procurement timelines on your side (and the name of the security reviewer), that will help us prioritize the SOC evidence bundle.

I've also dropped a short 'save plan' doc in the attachments (aurora_save_plan.docx) with suggested contour for canary terms and rollback triggers. Please reply inline with updates — want to close the red item or have an exec gating decision by EOD tomorrow.

Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: aurora_risk_flags_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), aurora_save_plan.docx (doc), aurora_hubspot_snapshot.pdf (export)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@aurora-ml.com>, Aurora-ML Procurement <procurement@aurora-ml.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Risk flags — playbook + exec asks (Aurora-ML)

Karthik — thanks for the concise playbook. Quick updates inline.

- Aurora Core (Red): Procurement has requested SOC2 Type II summary and a sample retention matrix. I checked with Finance — we can offer a $15k pilot credit without CPO approval; anything above requires exec sign-off (CFO/Head of Rev). I'll draft the credit request language so it's ready for escalation.
- Aurora Scale (Yellow): Buyer is pushing on unit economics for dedicated capacity. I propose a 6-week pilot at a slightly higher price with a performance SLI/SLO guarantee — gives them runway to prove latency/cost. Jordan, can you scope the SLI draft?
- Green: agreed, keep current cadence.

Marissa
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

On the Aurora Core pilot credit — we appreciate the flexibility. Would Aurora consider an incremental credit tied to milestone delivery (e.g., $7.5k on delivery of SOC artifacts, $7.5k on pilot go-live)? That structure helps procurement justify the spend.

Jordan — happy to do the infra health-check tomorrow at 10:30 PT. Send an invite and a short checklist so we can be prepared.

Thanks, all — short summary and next steps so we have a clean action log: 

1) Pilot credit structure: approved by Marissa up to $15k without exec signature. Marissa to provide final wording; contingency if Aurora wants milestone split (Aurora team proposed $7.5k/$7.5k) — we can accept, finance notified.
2) SOC evidence: Sean to assemble and send SOC2 summary + retention matrix to Miguel Ramos by EOD Friday. Procurement helped by Elena.
3) Infra health-check: Jordan to run 10:30 PT call tomorrow with Elena. Jordan — send calendar invite + short checklist (30m).
4) Escalation: If SOC deliverables slip beyond next Wednesday, I will escalate to Head of Rev for a timeboxed exec review (target: decision within 48 hours of escalation).

I'll update the aurora_risk_flags_v1.xlsx after Jordan's call and mark the Aurora Core row "Yellow (contingent)" if SOC artifacts are in-flight and pilot credit is accepted with milestones.

Please reply only if there are objections to the plan above. If not, I'll push the hubspot note and send an abbreviated exec summary for finance.

Karthik
